name: Blessed Water
text: The bearer may use this item on one of their weapons as a free action. Until the end of the battle, that weapon gains the blessed weapon rule.

name: Crimson Shade
text: The bearer may use this item as a free action. If they do, add 1 to their Move and Fight characteristics until the end of the battle. Then, in the aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 1-2, the fighter gains the 'Sticky Fingers' lasting injury.

name: Dark Venom
text: The bearer may use this item on one of their weapons as a free action. Until the end of the battle, that weapon gains the poisoned weapon rule.

name: Elven Cloak
text: When this fighter is targeted by a ranged attack action, it is considered to be in cover if it is more than 6" away from the attacking fighter.

name: Familiar
text: A `WIZARD` may use this item to ignore the effects of a single roll on the magical calamity table. Declare this after making the roll but before resolving its effects.

name: Grimoire
text: If the bearer is a `WIZARD`, they may use one additional magical ability from the list in their fighter profile.

name: Healing Draught
text: The bearer may use this item as a free action to immediately use the 'Respite' ability without needing or spending ability dice to do so.

name: Heavy Armour
text: Add 3 to the bearer's Armour characteristic, and subtract 1 from their Move characteristic.

name: Holy Relic
text: If the bearer is included in your warband, you begin each battle with 1 additional Wyrd dice.

name: Hunting Arrows
text: The bearer may use this item on one of their ranged weapons as a free action. Until the end of the battle, that weapon gains the piercing 1 weapon rule.

name: Lantern
text: Subtract 1 from the Bravery characteristic of friendly fighters within 3" of this fighter. However, enemy fighters may add 1 to their Shoot characteristic when targeting this fighter with ranged attack actions.

name: Light Armour
text: Add 1 to the bearer's Armour characteristic.

name: Lucky Charm
text: The bearer may use this item when targeted by an attack action, after the hit rolls have been made, to turn one critical hit into a hit.

name: Mad Cap Mushrooms
text: The bearer may use this item as a free action. Add 3 to this fighter's Fight characteristic until the end of the battle. It also gains the 'Stupidity' injury for the duration of the battle.

name: Master-Wrought Weapon
text: Purchase a weapon from the fighter's faction entry, and increase its gold coin cost by 100 gold coin. Then, add 1 to its hit damage and critical damage characteristics.

name: Mordheim Map
text: When this fighter's search party is deployed to the battlefield, each fighter in it can make a free Move action.

name: Prayer Beads
text: Once per battle round, this fighter can re-roll a failed Bravery test.

name: Rope and Hook
text: When the bearer climbs, they count as climbing a ladder. When climbing down, count only half of the vertical distance moved toward the fighter's Move characteristic (rounding up).

name: Shield
text: Increase the bearer's Fight characteristic by 1 when targeted by a melee attack action. When targeted by a ranged attack action, the bearer is considered to be in cover.

name: Smoke Bomb
text: The bearer may use this item to make a free Retreat action. During that action, enemy fighters within 3" of the bearer cannot make reactions.

name: Superior Blackpowder
text: Use this item during the ‘Present Warbands’ step. Until the end of the battle, remove the Unreliable weapon rule from all equipped weapons.

name: Unholy Relic
text: If the bearer is included in your warband, you begin each battle with 1 additional Wyrd dice.

name: Wyrdstone Pendulum
text: After making an exploration roll in the aftermath sequence, if the bearer is in the search party, you may add or subtract 1 from one dice result.
